correctness.rationale: Greedy embedding gives one canonical mask per distinct descendant. Classifying by adjacent, nonadjacent, and final-pair deletions yields the two endpoint and interior singleton penalties, including n=2. Alternating positive run compositions then give the full marked series; sampling distinct coordinates without replacement gives the mean, with the disjoint-pair term absent for n<4. For the limit, conditioning on the endpoint types turns floor(R/2), up to an integer shift, into a hypergeometric variable with population n−2, k−1 successes, and n−k−1, n−k, or n−k−2 draws respectively. This follows by complementing one run-composition binomial. Each endpoint law gives transition variance asymptotic to 4n alpha²(1−alpha)² and mean 2k(n−k)/n+O(1), so the hypergeometric CLT gives the same limit in the mixture. The bounded-by-O(n) singleton corrections and centered quadratic remainder vanish on the n^(3/2) scale. Multiplication by the limiting derivative 2 alpha(1−alpha) gives exactly the claimed centered Gaussian variance. A separately written prefix-subsequence DP reproduces the full histograms, means, and transition moments for all 16,380 words at lengths 2–13.
residual_risks: Finite verification does not prove the arbitrary-length claim or the normal limit; the combinatorial and hypergeometric arguments supply these. No sparse-density limit is claimed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A broader alphabet does not compensate for projection onto the marginal; the stated polynomial cannot be conditioned on an unrecorded statistic. A composition refinement of its method is possible in principle and not itself an existing coverage statement.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The frozen proof combines known ingredients but must add two-content run enumeration and fixed-content fluctuations. In particular a marginal variance does not imply the stated conditional Gaussian law at arbitrary density.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Reversing source and received word changes what is conditioned on and can retain embedding multiplicity; fixed-length radius one changes the descendant set entirely. Neither is an equivalent conditional spectrum. The explicit fixed-weight-two special case is credited as overlapping, not as a stronger result.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: These are relevant exact formula records, but none tabulates the full fixed-weight coefficient array. The bounded catalogue search does not establish priority globally.

originality.rationale: The per-word run identity and runs CLT are not credited as original. The supported distinction is the fixed-content law of distinct descendants, with the marked exact spectrum, mean and composition-dependent normal limit together. Prior inspected laws either omit the source-weight coordinate, enumerate a different ball, or condition on the received word. The foundational Swart–Ferreira text was not accessible; no inference about its whole contents is made.
residual_risks: Swart–Ferreira could contain additional conditional results beyond the credited per-word identity.

value.rationale: Fixed composition is a natural coding constraint that removes the random weight component of variation. The exact distribution across each weight class gives ball sizes and probabilities unavailable from the unconditional law; the limit quantifies nonzero residual fluctuations and how their leading scale changes with density. This is a complete conditional classification, not just an isolated conditional moment or a new proof of the run identity.
residual_risks: Binary alphabet, exactly two deletions, and interior limiting densities for the CLT.
